clue.text: Miss not being in a union?

definitions.text: Miss not being in a union?

parts.words: Miss not being in a union?
parts.note: a Miss is an unmarried woman, so the clue describes a single woman living independently, outside a marriage

explanation.surface: A question about a young woman who has not joined a trade union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'union' looks like a trade union, but it means marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names an independent single young woman, the counterpart of a bachelor.

clue.text: Singer embracing Jolson in New York city

indicators.note: embracing means the singer's letters wrap round the other piece

parts.note: a buffo is a comic singer in opera
Al Jolson was the American singer of The Jazz Singer

explanation.surface: An opera singer hugs Al Jolson somewhere in New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Buffalo is a large city in New York State, on Lake Erie.

clue.text: Fairly calm horse carrying unskilled labourers out East

indicators.note: out says the East letter is removed from the labourers

parts.note: coolies is an old word for unskilled labourers
horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H

explanation.surface: A placid horse bears workers who have left the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' does not mean containing here: in this down entry the labourers ride on top of the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: The suffix -ish softens the adjective, giving somewhat cool, that is rather unexcited.

clue.text: Cooking of truffle is not easy

indicators.note: cooking suggests the words are being worked over into a new form

explanation.surface: Preparing a truffle dish is hard work.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'of' and 'truffle' are rearranged; 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that takes much exertion is the opposite of simple.

clue.text: Class discipline

definitions.meaning: a rank or category, as in biological classification
... also means control, as in keeping ...

explanation.surface: Keeping a classroom in line.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a taxonomic rank, and the state of control in a group.

clue.text: Received note about a king's method of execution

indicators.note: about means the first pieces go round the others

parts.note: got means received
R is the abbreviation for rex, king
te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A message arrives concerning how a monarch is to be put to death.
explanation.definitionFit: Strangling with a cord or iron collar was a judicial killing, notably in Spain.

clue.text: Abusive language can be a barrier

definitions.meaning: bitter complaint or abuse, from rail at

explanation.surface: A remark that insults can stand between people.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is scolding invective; the other is a fence made of bars.

clue.text: Application for cut by management put on the wall

parts.note: a sticking plaster is applied to a cut
the board is a company's management

explanation.surface: Bosses stick a bandage on a wound and hang a notice up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheets of gypsum board are fixed to studs to form interior wall surfaces.

clue.text: We have this, it's said, at the start of a long-distance journey

definitions.text: We have this, it's said, at the start of a long-distance journey

parts.words: We have this, it's said, at the start of a long-distance journey
parts.note: mission control's famous announcement as a rocket leaves the pad begins 'We have', so the clue describes a launch into space

explanation.surface: Something announced as a long trip begins.
explanation.walkthrough: The long-distance journey is a space flight, not a road trip.
explanation.definitionFit: The moment a rocket rises from the launch pad starts its voyage.

clue.text: Renowned spinner taking off-drives hard

indicators.note: off suggests the letters are knocked out of order

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A famous spin bowler is struck for off-drives by a hard-hitting batsman.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture (a spinner bowling, off-drives being shots) hides a whirling religious figure; 'taking' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Whirling Sufi mystics are famous for their spinning dance.

clue.text: Break with colour British included in traditional architectural style

indicators.note: included means this letter is placed inside the other pieces

parts.note: half-time is the break in a match
red is a colour

explanation.surface: A pause in play, painted red with British touches, in an old building style.
explanation.definitionFit: Tudor-style buildings show exposed wooden frames filled with plaster or brick.

clue.text: Comparatively slippery fish that's found beside river

parts.note: the shad is a fish of the herring family
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A fish found next to a river is rather slimy.
explanation.definitionFit: Shady means dubious or untrustworthy, so the comparative is more shifty.

clue.text: Further legal proceedings subsequently rejected outside Eastern state

indicators.note: outside means the turned word wraps round the state
rejected means the word is sent back, read in reverse

parts.note: later means subsequently
RI is Rhode Island, an eastern US state

explanation.surface: A case brought again is thrown out later, beyond one eastern state.
explanation.definitionFit: A second hearing of a case in court is another legal proceeding.

clue.text: Policeman he's holding back a long time

indicators.note: back means the whole assembly is read in reverse
holding means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: he is taken as written; the 's is a link
a cop is a policeman

explanation.surface: An officer takes a man into custody for an age.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a long period marked by particular events.

clue.text: Boxer extremely lucky getting points during bout

indicators.note: during means these go inside the bout

parts.note: a fight is a bout

indicators.note: extremely means take the extreme letters, first and last, of the word

parts.note: W and E are compass points, west and east

explanation.surface: A fighter is very fortunate to win on points in his contest.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer of the lightest professional class is named after the division.

clue.text: Time of birth for nobody sensible

definitions.text: Time of birth for nobody sensible

parts.words: Time of birth for nobody sensible
parts.note: plays on the saying 'I wasn't born ...', claimed by anyone not naive

explanation.surface: A remark about when no wise person entered the world.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom 'I wasn't born yesterday' means I am not gullible.
explanation.definitionFit: The day before today is when, proverbially, no shrewd person was born.

clue.text: Reveals salt inside crustaceans

indicators.note: inside means the salt goes within the other word

parts.note: bares means reveals
NaCl is the chemical formula for common salt

explanation.surface: Uncovers salt within shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: These are crustaceans that cling to rocks and hulls.

clue.text: Unrestrained tirade about current measure

indicators.note: about means the tirade wraps round the measure

parts.note: a rant is a tirade
the amp is the unit of electric current

explanation.surface: An unchecked outburst concerning electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unchecked spreads wildly, as rampant growth does.

clue.text: Outrageous woman upset food colouring

parts.note: Anna is a woman's name

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, read in reverse

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means outrageous

explanation.surface: A shocking woman is distressed by a dye in her food.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces appear in the clue in the opposite order to the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An orange-red dye from the achiote tree is used to colour cheese.

clue.text: Record book containing positive results

definitions.meaning: a photo ... holds prints, the positives made from negatives

explanation.surface: A register holding favourable outcomes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'positive' looks like good news, but it means photographic prints.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both an LP and a book for keeping photographs.

clue.text: Eccentric has boil to get rid of

indicators.note: eccentric suggests the letters are out of their normal arrangement

explanation.surface: An odd person has a boil he wants removed.
explanation.definitionFit: To do away with something is to eliminate it entirely.

clue.text: Improve health in preparation for operation

definitions.meaning: the preparatory phase before a campaign or event

explanation.surface: Getting fit before going under the knife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'operation' looks surgical, but it is a military operation; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to strengthen; the other is the period of mounting effort before action.

clue.text: Aid worker necessary to calm one revolt

indicators.note: necessary to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A helper is needed to quieten an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically one who handed out alms, later a hospital social worker.

clue.text: Journalist managed without fortification

indicators.note: without means outside, so the managed piece goes round the other

parts.note: ran means managed
ED, editor, is a journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter coped without defences.
explanation.definitionFit: A V-shaped earthwork pointing towards an enemy forms a defensive structure.

clue.text: Sweetheart's reason for arousing strong feelings

parts.note: the heart of sweet is its middle letter
a motive is a reason

explanation.surface: A lover's grounds for stirring up passion.
explanation.definitionFit: An emotive issue is one stirring passion.

clue.text: Required to take up arms, prepared plan

definitions.meaning: to be conscripted into the forces
to have ... is to have written a preliminary version

explanation.surface: Called up for the army, one prepares a scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is conscripted into military service; the other is having sketched a preliminary document.

clue.text: Decline to replace con's son with daughter

indicators.note: to replace ... with says one letter is exchanged for another in the word

parts.note: a swindle is a con

explanation.surface: Refusing to swap a trickster's boy for his girl.
explanation.walkthrough: S is son and D daughter, the usual abbreviations.
explanation.definitionFit: To diminish gradually is to fall off in size or number.

clue.text: Special trophy set in a lawyer's office

indicators.note: special suggests these letters are reworked into a particular new form

explanation.surface: A unique cup put in a solicitor's room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' belongs to the fodder, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The position or tenure of an attorney is a legal post.
